top_signals.title: Philippines Seeks New Equilibrium With China
top_signals.summary: Philippine Ambassador to China Jaime FlorCruz says President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will travel to China for the APEC meetings as Manila seeks a “predictable” equilibrium with Beijing. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: China confirms first Xi-Trump-Putin summit on Thursday
top_signals.summary: Beijing did not offer details about the meeting, including what the topics of the historic summit in the Chinese city of Shenzhen would be.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump breaks silence about FAA nationwide ground stop, blames Biden administration
top_signals.summary: Trump blamed the Biden administration for the FAA’s aging system after a nationwide ground stop disrupted air travel and urged Congress to approve more funding.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
